policy.rule: A passing inference smoke test is not proof of perceptual enhancement. Do not auto-promote.

candidates.notes: 521 sound events; classifies audio but does not perform mastering

candidates.name: Beat This! small0
candidates.weights: Upstream model checkpoint; verify specific checkpoint attribution
candidates.notes: Existing Cyn experiment; whole-file latency unsuitable for realtime until tested

candidates.name: Silero VAD
candidates.notes: Compact ONNX candidate for dialogue/voice detection

candidates.name: DeepFilterNet
candidates.weights: Upstream package pretrained model; not redistributed
candidates.notes: Voice cleanup only; do not apply blindly to music

candidates.name: RNNoise
candidates.notes: No redistribution until weights permissions are clarified

candidates.name: PANNs Cnn14

candidates.name: LAION CLAP

candidates.name: Demucs

candidates.name: Spleeter
